# runr_model_service (Resource)

A model service: a Hugging Face model (or a model of the organization's library) served by an engine (vLLM, TGI, TEI, RunR's transformers / diffusers server or a custom image) on CPU or GPU in a region. `online` services download the model from the Hub into the region's model volume; `offline` services serve the region's offline copy and have no egress. Settings left out are RunR's pick (engine, device, size, scaling); a change of a running service redeploys it. Bind it to projects with `runr models bind` (`RUNR_MODEL_<ALIAS>_*` variables).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runr_region" "eu" {
  name = "eu-1"
}

# Embeddings on CPU: RunR picks the engine (TEI), size and scaling.
resource "runr_model_service" "embed" {
  hub_id    = "sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2"
  region_id = data.runr_region.eu.id
  min_scale = 1 # keep one instance warm
}

# Chat on a GPU, served from the region's offline copy (no egress).
resource "runr_model_service" "chat" {
  name      = "chat"
  hub_id    = "Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct"
  revision  = "main"
  region_id = data.runr_region.eu.id
  mode      = "offline"
  device    = "gpu"
  engine    = "vllm"
  gpu = {
    count      = 1
    memory_min = 24000
  }
  args    = ["--max-model-len", "8192"]
  timeout = "45m"
}

output "chat_openai_base" {
  value = runr_model_service.chat.openai_base
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `region_id` (String) Region id (`data.runr_region`). Changing it creates a new service.

### Optional

- `args` (List of String) Arguments appended to the engine's (the only arguments of a `custom` image).
- `cpu` (String) Kubernetes CPU quantity (default: from the model size).
- `device` (String) `cpu` or `gpu` (default: RunR's pick for the model).
- `engine` (String) `vllm`, `tgi`, `tei`, `transformers`, `diffusers` or `custom` (default: RunR's pick for the task and device).
- `env_vars` (Map of String, Sensitive) Extra environment variables (stored encrypted); they win over RunR's.
- `gpu` (Attributes) GPUs of a `gpu` service (default `{count = 1}`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gpu))
- `health_path` (String) Readiness path of a custom image (default: TCP).
- `hub_id` (String) Hugging Face Hub id (`organization/name`); the model is added to the library on first use. Exclusive with `model_id`.
- `image` (String) Image instead of the engine's (a mirror, a newer release; the image of a `custom` engine).
- `max_scale` (Number) Maximum instances (default 1).
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory in MiB (default: from the model size).
- `min_scale` (Number) Minimum instances (default 0; 1 keeps one warm).
- `mode` (String) `online` (default; from the Hub, cached in the region) or `offline` (the region's copy, no egress).
- `model_id` (String) Id of a model of the library (uploaded and imported models). Computed for `hub_id`.
- `name` (String) Service name (default: from the model's name). Changing it creates a new service.
- `port` (Number) Port a custom image listens on (default 8080).
- `revision` (String) Hub branch, tag or commit of `hub_id` (default `main`); the model is pinned to the commit it points to.
- `running` (Boolean) Deploy the service (`true`, default) or keep it stopped. A failed service is deployed again on the next apply.
- `scale_to_zero` (Boolean) Scale to zero instances when idle (default true).
- `served_name` (String) Model name of the OpenAI API (default: the model's name).
- `timeout` (String) How long `wait` waits (Go duration; large models take a while the first time).
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Request timeout in seconds (default 300).
- `wait` (Boolean) Wait until a deployed service is ready.

### Read-Only

- `api` (String) API of the engine: `openai`, `tei`, `runr` or `custom`.
- `id` (String) Model service id.
- `openai_base` (String) `<url>/v1` for engines with OpenAI-compatible routes.
- `service_name` (String) Knative Service name.
- `status` (String) `stopped`, `waiting_snapshot`, `deploying`, `ready` or `failed`.
- `status_message` (String) Reason of the status, if any.
- `url` (String) Cluster-local URL (projects of the region reach it; bound projects get it as `RUNR_MODEL_<ALIAS>_URL`).

<a id="nestedatt--gpu"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gpu`

Required:

- `count` (Number) Number of GPUs.

Optional:

- `memory_min` (Number) Least GPU memory per GPU in MiB.
- `type` (String) GPU product (node label), e.g. `NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <model service id or name>
terraform import runr_model_service.chat chat
```
